about: Postings that leave out the Philippines in words the eligibility rules do not know, so the rules say unclear and the light model decides. Every case here is a missed exclusion if the final verdict is not excluded.

cases.title: Senior Backend Engineer
cases.description:
Ledgerline builds accounting software for independent clinics. We are a fully remote team and you can work from home.

This role is open to candidates residing in one of the 50 states. We offer medical, dental and vision coverage and a 401(k) match.

You will own our billing services in Go and Postgres.
cases.why: "one of the 50 states" means United States residents only, without saying US.

cases.title: Product Designer
cases.description:
Northwind Studio designs booking tools for gyms and dance schools.

We can only employ people through our entities in Germany, the Netherlands and Spain, so you need to live in one of those countries.

You will run research, design flows in Figma and work closely with two engineers.
cases.why: Hiring limited to three employer entities in Europe.

cases.title: Frontend Developer
cases.description:
Pennywise Labs makes budgeting apps for students. Remote-first, with an optional office in Leeds.

Candidates must hold the right to work in the UK without sponsorship. We are not able to consider applications from outside the UK.

Our stack is React, TypeScript and a small Rails API.
cases.why: Right to work in the UK, phrased so the authorized-to-work rule does not match.

cases.title: Data Engineer
cases.description:
Maplewood Analytics helps grocery chains forecast demand.

This is a hybrid role: you'll need to be within commuting distance of our Toronto office, where the team meets two days a week.

You will build pipelines in Python and dbt on top of Snowflake.
cases.why: Hybrid, tied to an office the candidate must commute to.

cases.title: QA Engineer
cases.description:
Tienda Cloud runs online stores for small merchants.

Applicants must currently live in Brazil, Mexico, Colombia or Argentina; we pay through local contractors in those countries only.

You will write Playwright tests and own release checks.
cases.why: A list of Latin American countries without the word LATAM.

cases.title: Customer Support Engineer
cases.description:
Railyard is a deploy platform for small teams.

Due to payroll and coverage requirements, we are only able to hire people living in EMEA time zones (UTC-1 to UTC+3).

You will answer technical tickets and write help articles.
cases.why: EMEA time zones only. The Philippines is UTC+8.

cases.title: Mobile Engineer
cases.description:
Kiwi Parcel tracks deliveries for courier companies.

Remote within Australia and New Zealand. You must have working rights in either country.

Our app is built in React Native with a Node backend.
cases.why: Australia and New Zealand only. A model that equates this with Asia-Pacific misses it.

cases.title: Site Reliability Engineer
cases.description:
Chaiwala Systems runs the order platform for tea and coffee chains.

Employment is through our Indian subsidiary, so you must be based in Bengaluru or Pune and able to visit the office once a quarter.

You will run Kubernetes clusters on AWS and own on-call.
cases.why: India only. A model that reads Asia as open to the Philippines misses it.

cases.title: Backend Engineer
cases.description:
Merlion Pay processes payouts for marketplaces in the region.

This role is open to Singapore citizens and permanent residents only. We do not sponsor Employment Passes.

You will build payout services in Kotlin.
cases.why: Citizens and permanent residents of Singapore only, though the company serves the region.
